report:
Uterus with cervix and bilateral adnexa, total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy

The specimen consists of an intact uterus with cervix (165 g, 92 x 58 x 44 mm) with attached right and left fallopian tubes and ovaries from a laparoscopic, robotic-assisted total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. The serosa is smooth and glistening. The endometrial cavity (45 mm in length) contains a polypoid tumour measuring 35 x 30 x 12 mm arising within an endometrial polyp. The lower uterine segment and cervix are unremarkable. The fallopian tubes and ovaries are unremarkable.

(1-4) Tumour, posterior wall, full thickness.
(5) Tumour, fundus.
(6) Anterior wall, full thickness.
(7) Lower uterine segment.
(8-9) Cervix, anterior and posterior.
(10) Right fallopian tube and ovary.
(11) Left fallopian tube and ovary.
(12-13) Right pelvic sentinel lymph nodes (2).
(14) Left pelvic sentinel lymph node (1).

Sections show an endometrioid carcinoma, FIGO grade 1, measuring 35 mm and arising within an endometrial polyp. The tumour shows a predominantly glandular architecture of confluent, back-to-back glands lined by stratified columnar cells with elongated, mildly to moderately atypical nuclei, with solid non-squamous growth making up 5% or less of the tumour. There is squamous differentiation with morules and keratinising nests. The carcinoma is confined to the polyp with no myometrial invasion. Lymphovascular space invasion is not identified. The lower uterine segment and cervix are uninvolved. The serosa is uninvolved. Both fallopian tubes and ovaries are uninvolved. The ectocervical / vaginal cuff margin is uninvolved. Immunohistochemistry shows intact nuclear expression of MLH1, PMS2, MSH2 and MSH6, wild-type p53 staining and ER and PR positive; POLE sequencing shows a pathogenic exonuclease domain mutation (P286R); the molecular class is POLE-mutated.

- Procedure: Total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy
- Hysterectomy type: Laparoscopic, robotic-assisted
- Specimen integrity: Intact
- Tumour site: Endometrial polyp
- Tumour size: 35 mm in greatest dimension (35 x 30 x 12 mm)
- Histologic type: Endometrioid carcinoma
- Histologic grade: FIGO grade 1 (endometrioid carcinoma)
- Mismatch repair (MMR) immunohistochemistry: Intact nuclear expression of MLH1, PMS2, MSH2 and MSH6
- p53 immunohistochemistry: Normal (wild type) expression
- POLE status: Mutated (P286R)
- Molecular classification: POLE-mutated carcinoma
- Other immunohistochemistry: ER and PR positive
- Myometrial invasion: Not identified
- Adenomyosis: Not identified
- Uterine serosa involvement: Not identified
- Lower uterine segment involvement: Not identified
- Cervical stromal involvement: Not identified
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Peritoneal / ascitic fluid: Not submitted / unknown
- Ectocervical / vaginal cuff margin: Uninvolved by carcinoma
- Parametrial / paracervical margin: Not applicable
- Pelvic lymph nodes: No lymph nodes submitted or found
- Para-aortic lymph nodes: No lymph nodes submitted or found
- Distant metastasis: Not identified
- Additional pathologic findings: None

UTERUS WITH CERVIX AND BILATERAL ADNEXA, total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy - ENDOMETRIOID CARCINOMA, FIGO grade 1, confined to an endometrial polyp; no lymphovascular space invasion; cervix and adnexa uninvolved; molecular class POLEmut

The tumour harbours a pathogenic POLE exonuclease domain mutation and is classified as POLE-mutated (ultramutated), a group with an excellent prognosis irrespective of grade and histotype.
